Dr. Rupak K. Sarma Assistant Professor Dept. of Botany Nalbari College, Nalbari has been independently verified and ranked among the Worlds Top 5% Scientists in the 2025 SciRank Global Registry, based on rigorous bibliometric analysis.
Yoga-Sangam Patra : Certificate from Ministry of Ayush for helding International Day of Yoga 2025
Rajdeep Kashyap from Nalbari College set a record in the GUINNESS WORLD RECORDS , The fastest book writing in 9 hour, a philosophical book JONMO-PREM-MRITYU on 25th May 2024
Rank Holders in UG Courses Final Examination Gauhati University, 2024
Mayuri Kashyap from Nalbari College, Nalbari participated in the "National Youth Parliament 2023" organized by the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports, Govt. of India from 1.03.2023 to 2.03.2023
"Dr R C Shukla Award" to Dr. Dibashree Tamuli, Asst. Prof. Zoology Dept. for best research paper in Physiology. This was given by the "Association of Physiologists and Pharmacologists of India (APPI) in its 69th annual conference, from 30th, Nov - 2nd December, 2023 in AIIMS Kalyani, West Bengal.
Pubali Deka from Nalbari College set a record in the INDIA BOOK OF RECORDS and in the  ASIA BOOK OF RECORDS by making the smallest traditional Assamese JAPI Hat ( 2.2 cm) from waste paper, which was confirmed on 30th Oct 2021 and 22nd Nov, 2021 respectively. Pubali Deka also received the Professor H.N. Sharma award for securing highest mark in Geography honours ,in B.A/ B.Sc , under Gauhati University, 2022. She was awarded as the best graduate in Geography, 2022.
"B. K. Anand award" awarded to Dr. Dibashree Tamuli, Asst. Prof. Zoology Dept. for best research paper  in Physiology. This was given by the "Association of Physiologists and Pharmacologists of India (APPI) in its 68th annual conference, called APPICON 2022 from 13th - 15th December, 2022 in the GMCH & PGIMER, Chandigarh.
